text: maya: short q — for Create Endpoint form, do we use a visible 'Required' label or keep asterisk + sr-only? thoughts on grouping CPU/GPU fields? :thinking_face: sam: prefer visible 'Required' for clarity. asterisks get missed. but if form is long could be noisy. jordan: a11y win for explicit label. if we keep *, add visually-hidden "required" and aria-required. alex: agree. best practice: + input aria-required="true". also avoid color-only indicators. kevin: for CPU/GPU multi-field rows: show per-field microcopy on blur, but also a compact error summary at the top after submit with anchors. reduces cognitive load. tara: micro-errors + top summary makes keyboard flow easier. ensure the summary has role="alert" so screen readers announce it. jordan: validate-on-blur is my recommendation. don't show errors for untouched fields. show persistent summary only after submit attempt. maya: destructive actions: delete endpoint vs purge logs — do we use typed confirmation for both? typed is safer but high friction. kevin: tiered approach: use checkbox + confirm button for purge logs (recoverable-ish), require exact typed name for full-delete of endpoints or project. prefer case-insensitive match to avoid frustration. alex: accessibility notes: focus trap in modal, restore focus on close, announce confirmation text, label the typed input clearly, provide helpful error when mismatch. maya: UI idea: group related fields in a soft card with a group-level required note (sr-only) instead of repeating 'required' on each tiny field. keeps visual density down. tara: typo: name is tara, not tera :) but +1 on group card. add an optional 'why we need this' helper link in group header. sam: copy tweak: for top error summary use "Please fix the following errors to continue" then list items with short phrases and anchor links. jordan: small dev note: developers should set focus to first invalid field and add aria-invalid="true". also ensure error text id is referenced by aria-describedby on the input. maya: thanks — next steps: @jordan build Figma + small HTML prototype with explicit 'Required', group cards, blur validation, top summary behavior, and two modal patterns (checkbox vs typed). will share tomorrow for crit. :thumbsup: design-bot: Reminder — design review 2026-03-31 09:00 PT. Agenda: forms validation, grouped field patterns, destructive confirmation flows.
